title.en: Read relationally, comparison ranks consuming formation below its absence
title.zh: 以关系读生成：比较原则把消耗型形成排在其不发生之下

statement.zh: 以关系读生成时，没有超额取用者的接续更新每个条件并扩展有它的接续，这是对每个继续族成立的比较之律的实例，所以比较原则 C 把前者严格排在上面；逐事件读取时 C 不作此裁决。
statement.en: Read relationally, the course from which an overdrawing formation is absent renews every condition and extends the course with it, an instance of a law of comparison for every family of courses, so comparison principle C ranks it strictly higher; read event by event, C does not decide.

laws.zh: 对每个继续族，关系（整段）读法下，更新每个条件的继续扩展另一个继续，当且仅当它在另一个所记入的每个事件上活跃，并在另一个所扣下的某个事件上活跃；它每步每个形成都活跃时，当且仅当另一个扣下某个事件。
laws.en: For every family of courses, a course that renews every condition extends another under the relational (whole-run) reading exactly when it is active at every event the other includes and at some event the other withholds; where every formation is active at every step of it, exactly when the other withholds some event.

laws.zh: 以关系读生成，即以不消耗其所参与关系之条件的形成的发生为生成根据：生生之意义恰好肯定这些发生，对消耗者的发生沉默。
laws.en: Read relationally, so that the active events of formations not consuming conditions of the relations they participate in are the generative grounds, living significance includes exactly those events and is silent on a consumer's events.

laws.zh: 在关系性更新规律族中，凡焦点形成自某步起超出更新取用者，同一展开中该形成不发生的接续都更新每个条件，是有它的接续的生成扩展，为这一定律的实例；依存的（恶性增长）与不依存的（以消耗取胜）焦点形成同样成立。
laws.en: For every law of the relational-renewal family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal from some step on, the same unfolding without that formation renews every condition and is a generative extension of the unfolding with it, an instance of that law; this holds for a dependent (malignant) and an independent (winning) focal formation alike.

laws.zh: 因此比较原则 C 把没有超额取用者的接续严格排在上面，任何满足 C 的非对称比较都不能偏好超额取用。
laws.en: So the comparison principle C ranks the unfolding without the overdrawing formation strictly higher, and no asymmetric comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw.

laws.zh: 逐事件读取时，两条接续互不扩展，并存在满足 C、非自反且传递的比较偏好超额取用。
laws.en: Read event by event, the two unfoldings are incomparable by extension, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw.

laws.zh: 两种读法下，共享都是以消耗取胜的生成扩展，是同一定律的实例，逐事件读法下是“读法在扩展者上精确时的扩展之律”的实例。
laws.en: Sharing is a generative extension of winning by consumption under both readings, an instance of the same law and, under the event-by-event reading, of the law of extension for a reading exact on the extending course.

hypotheses.zh: C（ComparisonPrinciple）是排序定理的假设，所以比较使用 C 而非 G0；G0 只出现在接口定理 g0_relational 中。二者原样导入自 GenerativeComparison。
hypotheses.en: C (ComparisonPrinciple) is a hypothesis of the ranking theorems, so the comparisons use C, not G0; G0 appears only in the interface theorem g0_relational. Both are imported unchanged from GenerativeComparison.

Relational reading: a claim is a formation event (formation, step); in a continuation it is a ground when the formation is active then and is not ConsumingIn that continuation. The classification is over the whole continuation.
hypotheses.zh: 关系读法：主张是形成发生（形成，步）；在某接续中，该形成此时发生且在该接续中不是 ConsumingIn，即为根据。分类就整条接续而言。

hypotheses.en: The comparison course without the focal formation keeps the law's start, renewal and support level, with no focal activity and no drawing; the support of the sustaining formation holds at the start (needG ≤ start), and needF ≤ needG, 0 < needG and overdraw from some step T0 are as in relational-renewal-classification.
hypotheses.zh: 无焦点形成的对照接续保持规律的起始水平、更新与支持阈值，焦点不发生也不取用；起始时维持者受支持（needG ≤ start），并沿用 relational-renewal-classification 中的 needF ≤ needG、0 < needG 及自 T0 起超额取用。

does_not_show.zh: 这里的比较是该定律在一个规律族及其无焦点对照接续中的实例。
does_not_show.en: The rankings are the law's instances in one law family and its course without the focal formation.

does_not_show.zh: 分类就整条接续而言，所以消耗型形成在超额取用之前的发生也不计为根据；本记录不确定逐步读法。
does_not_show.en: Classification is per whole continuation, so a consuming formation's events before its overdraw are not grounds; this record settles no stepwise reading.

does_not_show.zh: 不排序混合情形，不判定波动情形。
does_not_show.en: Ranks no mixed cases and decides no fluctuating ones.

does_not_show.zh: 不确立可行性或义务，也不确立真实对应。
does_not_show.en: Establishes neither feasibility nor obligation, nor real correspondence.

does_not_show.zh: 与 renewing-consuming-formation 一样，规律若不表示休息的恢复作用，两种读法下 C 都会把休息排在持续的更新型形成之下；休息不是消耗，但这一比较没有表示它的价值。
does_not_show.en: As in renewing-consuming-formation, a law that omits rest's restorative role makes C rank rest below continued renewing formation under either reading; rest is not consumption, but this comparison does not represent its value.

detail.en: broad_comparison_admits_overdraw: under the event-by-event reading, a strict comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw. C alone, without the relational reading of generation, does not rank malignant growth below its absence.
detail.zh: broad_comparison_admits_overdraw：逐事件读法下，有满足 C 的严格比较偏好超额取用。没有对生成的关系读法，单靠 C 不能把恶性增长排在其不发生之下。

detail.en: tradeoff_has_opposite_strict_appraisals: when each continuation realizes grounds the other lacks, C does not decide; mixed occurrences that renew some conditions and consume others are not ranked here.
detail.zh: tradeoff_has_opposite_strict_appraisals：各接续互有对方缺少的根据时，C 不裁决；对部分条件更新、对另一些条件消耗的混合发生，本结果不排序。

correspondence.en: Reading G0's 'generation' relationally follows Ren's G0, whose object is 生生 ('整体中的生及其继续生成'), and Ren's follow-up that generation and degeneration do not overlap; that reading and C's defense as an articulation of 'a whole direction of ever more 生' are philosophical, not established by the audit. The comparison course is the same unfolding without the focal formation, not a feasible alternative; feasibility and selection belong to P/N and the situation.
correspondence.zh: 以关系读 G0 的“生成”，依据的是 Ren 的 G0——对象为生生（“整体中的生及其继续生成”）——及其追问“generative 和 degenerate 不 overlap”；这一读法以及把 C 作为“整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”之比较表述的辩护，属于哲学论证，审计不确立。对照接续是同一展开中没有该形成的情形，不是可行选项；可行与选择属于 P/N 与情境。

detail.zh: 导入 RelationalRenewal，直接调用 overdraw_consuming、within_renewal_renewing、within_renewal_sustains、independent_overdraw_persists 与 renewing_not_consuming。

output.en: overdraw_consuming: the focal formation is ConsumingIn, and from some step T the sustaining formation is never active.
output.zh: overdraw_consuming：焦点形成为 ConsumingIn，且自某步 T 起维持性形成不再发生。

input.en: overdraw_relational_extension excludes the focal events from the grounds and takes the sustaining event at T as the extension's new ground.
input.zh: overdraw_relational_extension 由此把焦点发生排除在根据之外，并以 T 时的维持性发生作为扩展新增的根据。

conditions.en: Same Law, 0 < needG, needF ≤ needG, overdraw from T0; additionally needG ≤ start for the course without the focal formation.
conditions.zh: 同一规律，0 < needG，needF ≤ needG，自 T0 起超额取用；另需 needG ≤ start 以支持无焦点的对照接续。

detail.en: Interpretive: C is the explicit comparison premise of the G0/J route; this result shows what C decides once G0's generation is read relationally. No Lean input from that record.
detail.zh: 解释关联：C 是 G0/J 路线中公开的比较前提；本结果说明以关系读 G0 的生成后，C 能裁决什么。未以该记录作 Lean 输入。

detail.en: Its event_reading_recognizes_both and comparison_does_not_apply give the broad event reading under G0 and C for a wear law: G0 includes both continuations and C does not apply between them, agreeing with overdraw_broad_incomparable here. This record adds that the relational reading lets C rank the overdraw below its absence. No import either way.
detail.zh: 其 event_reading_recognizes_both 与 comparison_does_not_apply 给出磨损规律下 G0 与 C 的逐事件广义读法：G0 肯定两条接续，C 在二者之间不适用，与此处 overdraw_broad_incomparable 一致。本记录补充的是：关系读法使 C 能把超额取用排在其不发生之下。互不导入。

detail.en: Same pattern: a structural description fed into C decides a case that a coarser description cannot. Different structure (joint bundles there, consumption here); no formal composition.
detail.zh: 同一模式：把结构描述送入 C，裁决较粗描述无法裁决的情形。结构不同（彼为联合束，此为消耗）；无形式组合。

detail.en: Interpretive: uses the same G0 predicate; here its inventory is read relationally.
detail.zh: 解释关联：使用同一 G0 谓词；此处其库存按关系读取。
该结果给出逐步与关系层读法；本记录的排序在逐步读法下的命运由 ranking-under-readings 证明。
detail.en: That result gives the stepwise and relation-level readings; ranking-under-readings proves what becomes of this record's rankings under the stepwise reading.

detail.zh: 该结果在核心上重述本记录的整段排序，并证明逐步读法下对不在场的排序失去、对共享的排序保持。
detail.en: That result restates this record's whole-run ranking on the core and proves that under the stepwise reading the ranking of absence is lost and that of sharing is kept.
